column1: # gate-tools.tsv - the tools a tools/testrunner command unit may ask for
# (scripts/ci/gate-commands.tsv, tools column), pinned by version and sha256
# per architecture. tools/testrunner/bootstrap.sh installs a tool once per
# worker from this row and refuses a tarball whose sha256 differs.
# Columns (tab separated): tool  version  arch  sha256  url
# golangci-lint: the version ci.yml's lint job pins (golangci-lint-action
# node: ci.yml pins only the major (`node-version: '22'`, setup-node takes
#   the newest 22.x); the runner pins the newest 22.x at the time of writing,
#   v22.23.5, with the sha256 from nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.5/SHASUMS256.txt.
